name: Metronome Synth USD
oneLiner: msUSD is Metronome's overcollateralized synth stablecoin minted against USDC, DAI, ETH, WBTC, and Vesper yield tokens at 75-85% CF, with no direct redemption.
collateral: USDC, DAI, ETH, WBTC, sfrxETH, and Vesper Finance yield-bearing tokens (vaUSDC, vaETH, vaSTETH, vaRETH, vaCBETH); FRAX and vaFRAX accepted but currently inactive; collateral factors range 75–85%
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP: users deposit crypto collateral (CF 75–85%) to mint msUSD at a fixed 1% annual fee; no direct redemption — only debt repayment to reclaim collateral. Peg maintained by zero-slippage intra-protocol synth swaps (Synth Marketplace) that arbitrageurs exploit when msUSD trades below par, plus collateral-provider buybacks of discounted msUSD

sources.label: Metronome Synth deposit and mintage caps

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened Metronome primary docs and the 2026-07-30 post-mortem on 2026-08-08. Deposit/mintage caps still enumerate eligible msUSD collateral (USDC, DAI, FRAX, ETH, WBTC, sfrxETH, and Vesper va-tokens) with per-asset caps and CF-based mintage formula. The post-mortem discloses that the synth swap module accumulated unbacked float, leaving ~4.57 million msUSD (and ~6,367 msETH) in circulation without matching debt positions at the time of disclosure; the protocol has deployed protocol-owned liquidity and defensive positions sized to close the gap if msUSD/msETH depeg by roughly 30%. Because pools are cross-margin multi-synth, DepositToken balances still cannot be attributed solely to msUSD without debt-side attribution the issuer does not publish. No public dashboard, attestation, or dual-source on-chain snapshot of current msUSD-specific weights was found, so the documented eligible envelope is retained as one 100% basket-needs-split row rather than a fabricated allocation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Metronome Synth collateral-cap, supported-assets, liquidation documentation, and July 2026 underbacking post-mortem (re-opened 2026-08-08)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current deposited balances and weights across the eligible collateral set are not published in the reviewed issuer documentation, cross-margin multi-synth pooling prevents treating raw DepositToken supplies as msUSD-only composition, and the July 2026 post-mortem confirms a period of underbacking in the synth swap module that left approximately 4.57 million msUSD without matching debt positions.

Vesper pool contracts underlying va-token collateral

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is pooled per asset in non-custodial DepositToken contracts with per-user debt tracked separately; plain assets (ETH, WBTC, USDC, DAI, FRAX) sit idle in those contracts, while Vesper va-token collateral (vaETH, vaUSDC, vaFRAX, and similar) represents positions whose underlying Vesper pools deploy capital into yield strategies by design — hence conditional reuse. No legal segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, or rehypothecation terms exist for contract custody; published audits could not be located in primary sources.

oracleRisk.summary: Five registered Metronome msUSD Pools span Ethereum, Optimism, Base, and Hemi. Ethereum, Optimism, and Base use Chainlink collateral feeds with no alternate provider; Hemi wires RedStone main/fallback providers but its main path is currently unconfigured, so live collateral prices use RedStone push feeds. Every branch hardcodes msUSD debt at $1, liquidates immediately with no protocol bad-debt backstop, and stops liquidations during reversible shutdown.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 data research
branchApplicability.rationale: Finalized registry and Pool reads found five callable msUSD CDP issuance pools: two registered Ethereum pools, one Optimism pool, one Base pool, and one Hemi pool. Each is an independent cross-margin branch with its own registered collateral set and DebtToken; Ethereum Pool 2 is dormant but remains active and capped for new issuance. Plasma has active bridge and AMO mint authority but its PoolRegistry has no registered pools and a dead-address master oracle, so it has no borrower debt or liquidation branch. The legacy BSC pool is unregistered with zero msUSD and DebtToken supply, and retired Avalanche used a distinct zero-supply vsUSD system. The five rows therefore exhaust every live or debt-bearing msUSD collateral-liquidation branch.

branches.label: Ethereum Pool 1 cross-margin branch
branches.summary: The primary Ethereum Pool has live msUSD debt and values twelve registered collateral tokens through Chainlink plus Vesper, Curve, and share-rate transformations, while valuing msUSD debt at a fixed dollar.

Chainlink USDC/USD -> direct USDC value; Vesper pricePerShare -> vaUSDC value
Chainlink ETH/USD -> direct WETH value; Vesper pricePerShare -> vaETH value
Chainlink DAI/USD -> direct DAI value
Chainlink BTC/USD -> direct WBTC value
Chainlink FRAX/USD -> inactive FRAX value; Vesper pricePerShare -> inactive vaFRAX value
Chainlink stETH/ETH 0x86392dC19c0b719886221c78AB11eb8Cf5c52812 x ETH/USD x Vesper pricePerShare -> vaSTETH value
Chainlink rETH/ETH 0x536218f9E9Eb48863970252233c8F271f554C2d0 x ETH/USD x Vesper pricePerShare -> vaRETH value

Chainlink ETH/USD x Curve WETH/frxETH price_oracle clamped to [0.9, 1.0] x sfrxETH pricePerShare

branches.fallbackBehavior: MasterOracle selects a token-specific oracle when configured and otherwise the default ChainlinkOracle; a configured custom-oracle failure does not fall through to the default. ChainlinkOracle rejects nonpositive or stale data and reverts, with no second provider or stored-last-good fallback. Vesper, Curve, and share-rate legs have no independent freshness timestamp, while msUSD debt remains fixed at $1.

collateralParameters.note: Legacy inactive DepositToken 0x608249cc11728E3b978f7B27F1EA13F607D484EF has a raw collateral factor of one wei of WAD and residual deposited balance.
Legacy inactive DepositToken 0x63EC45313149b1fa677b2b91CB93880232EF63AC has a raw collateral factor of one wei of WAD and residual deposited balance.

branches.liquidationMechanism: A permissionless caller may liquidate any other account immediately when current oracle-valued debt exceeds the sum of oracle-valued collateral multiplied by each collateral factor. The caller burns its own msUSD, the Pool burns the borrower's matching DebtToken, and the selected DepositToken seizes oracle-quoted collateral equal to repayment value plus a 10% liquidator incentive and 8% protocol fee. Each call is capped at 50% of that borrower's selected debt-token balance; debtFloorInUsd is zero.
branches.backstop: No Stability Pool, collateral auction, insurance reserve, governance-token debt auction, or other bad-debt absorber exists in the reviewed Pool, DebtToken, FeeProvider, or registry graph. Liquidations are funded only by external liquidators supplying msUSD and are limited by available borrower collateral.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Pool.liquidate reverts if the requested seizure exceeds the borrower's selected collateral balance. Collateral-backed partial liquidations can continue, but collateral-exhausted debt remains on the borrower's DebtToken balance; the reviewed contracts expose no write-off, redistribution, or socialization path. Governor or guardian shutdown sets everythingStopped and pauses issue, repay, deposit, withdraw, liquidate, and swap; the governor can later call open(), so shutdown is reversible but also disables liquidation while active.

branches.label: Hemi Pool 1 cross-margin branch
branches.summary: The live Hemi Pool has nonzero msUSD debt and values WETH, USDC, USDT, and USDC.e through a RedStone main/fallback adapter whose pull-cache main route was unconfigured at the reviewed block, leaving push feeds as the active path.

feeds.path: msUSD debt hardcoded to $1; no market-price or depeg input
Unconfigured RedStone pull-cache main -> RedStone push ETH feed 0xb9D0073aCb296719C26a8BF156e4b599174fe1d5 -> WETH value
Unconfigured RedStone pull-cache main -> shared RedStone push USDC feed 0x31a36CdF4465ba61ce78F5CDbA26FDF8ec361803 -> USDC and USDC.e values
Unconfigured RedStone pull-cache main -> RedStone push USDT feed 0xe8D9FbC10e00ecc9f0694617075fDAF657a76FB2 -> USDT value

branches.fallbackBehavior: MainAndFallbackOracle first accepts a positive main-provider value within the token's 86,400-second outer bound. The RedStone pull-cache main additionally returns zero outside its 60-second cache tolerance; at observation it returned zero for every collateral. The contract then uses RedStone push fallback subject to the 86,400-second bound. If both paths are zero or stale it reverts both-providers-failed; there is no stored-last-good path beyond the push feed's latest round. Both routes share RedStone and the main was unusable, so this is not provider redundancy.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-31 across all five tracked EVM deployments (Ethereum block 25648904, Optimism 154927378, Base 49332093, Hemi 4965568, Plasma 28513144). Each proxy resolves to the Metronome SyntheticToken implementation family; the exact verified source exposes seize(address from,address to,uint256) and gates it to registered Pool or DebtToken contracts, with no holder allowance. Its _transfer path moves any holder balance to a beneficiary, so this is direct holder-selective seizure even though there is no blacklist mapping. Live poolRegistry() reads were 0x11ead85c679eaf528c9c1fe094bf538db880048a (Ethereum), 0xe7c65eaeb1ca920f0db73cdfb4915dd31472a6a1 (Optimism), 0x4372a2b9304296c06197a823f25cf03119d2fd82 (Base), 0xdbd9cfb0b54c08e75085f8c8844e8054d13bd39a (Hemi), and 0x1c1c67e52942f4dd20a7262a9d17ea2a2e16acf3 (Plasma); their governor() controls pool registration and returned 0xd1de3f9cd4ae2f23da941a67ca4c739f8dd9af33 (Ethereum), 0xe01df4ac1e1e57266900e62c37f12c986495a618 (Optimism/Base/Plasma), and 0x468f87db090bc61c690cd86430b5407675b99242 (Hemi). Failure domain: Metronome pool/debt-token contracts and each chain's PoolRegistry governor.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Metronome Synth msUSD is natively issued on every deployed chain: each deployment is a 2,739-byte EIP-1967 proxy whose minting is controlled by that chain's Metronome Synth core under Metronome DAO governance, not by a third-party bridge. DefiLlama records every chain's msUSD supply as issued.
